newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 5.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The government closes university student residences in commercial capital Abidjan; blames insecurity and violence witnessed on the campuses in second city Bouake and Abidjan. - Marketing company Research International sponsors Quantum International in Ivory Coast. Quantum International to conduct research in sectors ranging from trade to banking, insurance hotels and communications.
- Slash and burn farming and human settlement remain a persistent threat to Ivory Coast's dwindling rain forest, experts from state forest agency SODEFOR say.
- Students at Ivory Coast's elite higher education institutions ask that their exams be postponed after closure of student residences
